character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a full-body chibi pixel-art character of a Black woman who uses a wheelchair. She has deep brown skin, a warm and friendly expression, expressive dark brown eyes, and naturally styled hair that complements her appearance.

She is wearing a stylish casual green outfit, consisting of a green blouse or sweater, matching green pants, and simple comfortable shoes. Her wheelchair is predominantly black, with a sleek modern design, black wheels, and detailed pixel-art shading. The wheelchair should be naturally integrated into the character's pose and clearly visible as part of the character.

Use a cute chibi design with an oversized head, expressive eyes, simplified facial features, and a compact stylized body. Render the character in detailed retro pixel art with crisp pixel edges, subtle highlights and shadows, and a polished video-game sprite aesthetic.

Full body, centered composition, entire wheelchair visible, front three-quarter view, natural relaxed posture, friendly expression, clean silhouette, transparent or simple plain background. No table, no food, no additional characters, no cropped body.
